name: play
description: Plays a song: now (clears the queue), or next (right after the current track). Pass what the user asked for as the query.

query.description: Song title and/or artist, or a genre, e.g. 'Blinding Lights'.

name: playback
description: Controls music playback. 'stop' also clears the queue; 'resume' is for 'play' or 'resume' without a song name.

action.description: pause, resume, stop, next or previous.

name: music_settings
description: Turns autoplay (recommendations when the queue runs out) or caching (saving streamed songs to the SD card) on or off.

name: notes
description: The user's text notes on the device. list: names, sizes, dates. read/write (replaces)/append (adds a line): one note by name. delete: two steps - call without confirmed (nothing is deleted; it says which exist), read the names to the user, and only after they agree call again with the same names and confirmed=true.

action.description: list, read, write, append or delete.

name.description: Note file name for read/write/append, e.g. 'shopping.txt' (letters, digits, '-', '_', '.').

names.description: For delete: exact note names, at most 10.

confirmed.description: Delete only: true on the second call, after the user agreed.

name: set_led_strip
description: Configures the solid status color of the RGB LED ring (for system idle states).

name: ringing_alarm
description: Stops or snoozes the alarm or timer that is ringing.

name: set_alarm
description: Sets an alarm at hour:minute local time (24-hour clock). One-time unless repeat days are given. An alarm at the same time and days is updated instead of duplicated. Returns the id and when it rings next.

days.description: Repeat days: 'once' (default), 'daily', 'weekdays', 'weekends', or day names like 'mon, wed, fri'.

day.description: For a one-time item: 'today', 'tomorrow', a day name, or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the next time the clock shows hour:minute.

tone.description: Optional tone: a built-in one (classic, chime, digital, rising), a tone file the user uploaded, or a downloaded song from the library (title or artist). Default: the classic built-in tone. A briefing alarm takes only an uploaded file (its music).

enabled.description: False to create or keep the alarm switched off. Default true.

type.description: 'briefing': a briefing alarm, which wakes the user with soft music (a file from the alarm folder, else the briefing music, else a soft tone) and gives a spoken morning briefing (weather, today's schedule, headlines). 'alarm' (default): a normal alarm with a tone, no briefing. Omit to leave unchanged.

briefing_start.description: Briefing alarms only. 'after_stop' (default): the music rings until the user stops it, then the briefing. 'automatic': the briefing starts at the alarm time over the music, and the music keeps ringing after it until the user stops it.

name: set_timer
description: Starts a countdown timer that rings like an alarm when it ends.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds, e.g. 1200 for 20 minutes. At most 24 hours.

name: schedule
description: Schedules something for later: a reminder to tell the user, or an action for you to carry out (play music, set the volume, read the news, run a routine from the note 'routines'). At the time you get the instruction back and do it. Give either in_minutes, or hour and minute (with optional day or repeat days). Alarms and timers have their own tools.

text.description: The instruction, written for yourself: 'Remind the user to call the bank', 'Play lofi music at volume 30', 'Run the routine good night'.

days.description: Repeat days: 'once' (default), 'daily', 'weekdays', 'weekends', or day names like 'mon, wed, fri'.

day.description: For a one-time item: 'today', 'tomorrow', a day name, or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the next time the clock shows hour:minute.

in_minutes.description: Instead of hour and minute: this many minutes from now.

kind.description: 'reminder' (default): the device chimes and you tell the user. 'action': no chime; you carry it out.

name: list_schedule
description: Lists alarms, running timers and scheduled items (reminders and actions) with their ids, times, repeat days and when each is next; says which alarm is ringing or snoozed and which reminders are pending.

name: cancel_scheduled
description: Deletes an alarm, timer, reminder or scheduled action by id (ids from list_schedule).

kind.description: 'alarm' (alarms and timers) or 'reminder' (reminders and scheduled actions).

name: acknowledge_reminders
description: Marks all pending reminders as heard. Use when the user says they got them or have done them.

name: save_to_memory
description: Appends the specified information to the device's persistent long-term memory file. Use this when the user explicitly asks you to remember something, or when you learn important personal facts, preferences, or notes about the user.

text.description: The exact fact, preference, or note to be appended to the memory file.

name: get_weather
description: Current weather and a daily forecast (up to 7 days) from Open-Meteo. Without a location it uses the device's home location. Temperatures in degrees Celsius.

location.description: City name, e.g. 'Pune' or 'Paris'. Omit for the home location.
